status: candidate frozen references; derived and cross-checked by the author TASK, not yet independently refuted
theory: the weight W of a component at its centre of gravity r (global X/Y/Z from the component node, the owner's R10 convention of 2026-10-24) is the nodal wrench F = W g_hat, M = r x F; small-displacement linear-elastic space frame, Euler-Bernoulli or Timoshenko with the energy-matched annular shear factor; a member with DEC-045 stiffness scale s has stiffness s K; annular section, Iy = Iz = I, J = 2I

conventions.wrench: global force and moment components at the component node; a primitive is emitted for the force along the gravity axis and for each nonzero moment component
conventions.support_reaction: global action of the support on the structure at its node (moments about that node)
conventions.section_action: element-local action on the +x face of the i-side portion at station s/L (local x from i to j); a node-on-element end action is -section(0) at end_i and +section(1) at end_j

criterion: |observed - expected| <= 1e-9 * |expected|; an exactly zero expectation uses 1e-9 * zero_scale of its family (largest nonzero magnitude of that family in the case; for a wrench, the weight or the largest moment, or the weight times the largest offset when every moment is zero)
